proof_summary: Writing the quotient as \(U(m)/D(m)\), exactness follows from \(v_q(U(m))=\sum_{s\ge1}\lfloor m/q^s\rfloor^2\) (counting pairs whose gcd is divisible by \(q^s\)) and \(v_q(D(m))=\sum_i i\sum_{s\ge1}\lfloor m/(iq^s)\rfloor\), together with \(\sum_i i\lfloor N/i\rfloor\le N^2\). For \(m=np+k\) with \(k<p\), the new rows and columns contribute no \(p\)-factor to \(U\), while Legendre’s formula shows every term of \(v_p(D)\) is unchanged since \(\lfloor(np+k)/(ip^s)\rfloor=\lfloor np/(ip^s)\rfloor\), and the newly indexed factorials have valuation zero; subtracting these equal valuations proves the result.
